name: United Drilling Tools Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, United Drilling Tools Ltd is in the production and sale of Oil Drilling tools and Equipment[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
UDT is a manufacturer of Large OD multi-start casing connectors and casing pipes, wireline winches, artificial gas lift equipment downhole tools, and high-performance connectors, used in the oil, gas, drilling, and allied industries.

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 33.4%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 9.03% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 4.57% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 185 days.
